subject: Energy
title: Off-Grid Solar Revolution
description: A 60-second lesson on Off-Grid Solar Revolution.

hook.text: Small solar panels with batteries are bringing electricity to remote villages—skipping the grid entirely.

buildup.text: Pay-as-you-go solar kits cost a few dollars per month—providing light, phone charging, and radio to off-grid homes.

discovery.text: Companies like M-KOPA and d.light have served tens of millions of households across East Africa with solar kits.

twist.text: Mobile money (M-Pesa) enabled the business model—rural customers pay via phone, no bank account needed.

climax.text: Off-grid solar is growing 20% annually—the fastest path to energy access for the world's poorest populations.

punchline.text: No wires needed—solar plus phone equals power for all.

quiz.question: What payment method enabled off-grid solar in Africa?
